mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS store_id,s.store_code,s.store_name, d.id AS device_id,d.device_code,d.device_name,d.last_active_at, (d.fcm_token IS NOT NULL) AS has_push_token, r.id AS request_id,r.status,r.expires_at, log.event AS last_event,log.message AS last_event_message FROM stores s LEFT JOIN devices d ON d.store_id=s.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT id,status,expires_at FROM pda_find_requests WHERE device_id=d.id AND store_id=s.id ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1 ) r ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT event,message FROM pda_alert_logs WHERE request_id=r.id ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1 ) log ON true ORDER BY s.store_code,s.id,d.device_code,d.id
